{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print("Number of -1 values in customer_age:", (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check for the QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
print("Number of QA orders (revenue == 999999.99):", (df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum())

# Check for refunded orders
print("Number of refunded orders:", (df['status'] == 'refunded').sum())

# Check unique values in key columns
print("Unique channels:", df['channel'].unique())
print("Unique customer segments:", df['customer_segment'].unique())

# Summary of conversion rate by segment
conversion_by_segment = df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean() * 100
conversion_by_segment.sort_values(ascending=False)"}
